project.name: Blackstar Raiders
project.type: deterministic-first tactical RPG / strategic exploration prototype
project.safety_rule: Use original dark gothic sci-fi genre logic, but avoid official protected names, logos, factions and symbols.

storage_model.notion: human project hub, reference upload surface, plan and tasks
storage_model.github: source of truth for rules, data, runtime, tests and versioned decisions
storage_model.drive_or_notion_uploads: heavy visual references and raw image assets
storage_model.render_rule: Image generation never defines facts. Data/state/log/payload defines facts.

v0.48.purpose: Separate combat mechanics from setting pack.

v0.50.name: Battle Screen Pre-render
v0.50.purpose: Validate tactical battle screen before final image generation.
rules: heroes and enemies are positioned from payload
battle units must be proportional to hexes
hero battlefield models match hero page canon
victory screen numbers come from data, not generation

v0.51.name: Strategic Sector Map
v0.51.previous_problem: The first strategic pre-render still used route lines and looked like a board path.
v0.51.correction: Strategic map must be an open-world 32x32 hex sector with fog, terrain, event points, units and scouting.

v0.52.name: Strategic Open World + Fog Runtime
v0.52.goal: Make the strategic map behave like a real explorable sector rather than a route-line board.
required_systems: tile states: unknown / visible / scanned / discovered

correct_direction: intel data improves understanding of surrounding tiles, events and units
wrong_direction: fixed three-lane road as main UI
fantasy map that ignores data states

reference_lock.hero_page: canon for EZ / Candy Peace / Dr.Feed appearance
reference_lock.strategic_fog_map: reference for 32x32 open-world map with fog, terrain and units
reference_lock.battle_screen: reference for tactical UI; must obey payload and unit scale
reference_lock.victory_screen: reference for result UI; numbers and hero visuals must be corrected from canon/data

hard_rules: Data first: state -> action log -> payload -> pre-render -> final visual.
No route lines on strategic map unless they represent temporary player-planned path overlay.
Hero visuals must remain consistent across hero page, battle screen and victory screen.
All victory numbers must come from run data.
8x8 is not the normal battle size anymore.
immediate_tasks: Generate updated map payload after scout/move.
Generate tactical 12x12 encounter from discovered point.
